notes: Fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 (data.js fy 'Jun 2026'); this edition skips FY2025. Financial figures are from the FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001193125-26-323660, filed July 29, 2026) and match SEC XBRL. OWNERSHIP: the proxy published after that fiscal year (DEF 14A filed October 21, 2026, accession 0001193125-26-427849, for the December 8, 2026 annual meeting) lists beneficial ownership only for current directors, nominees and named executives (as of September 30, 2026), plus holders above 5%. Bill Gates is in neither table (he is not a director or named executive), so his stake is not reported in the company's filings: status no-reported-stake, values null. Nothing is filled from other sources. The two 5% holders' percentages are the proxy's 'Percent of Class to be Voted During the Meeting'. Vanguard is now reported as Vanguard Capital Management LLC (Schedule 13G filed April 30, 2026); BlackRock's figure still rests on a Schedule 13G/A filed February 13, 2024, so it is stale. The proxy gives filing dates, not the dates the holdings refer to, so asOf is null. BUYBACKS: the $22,271 million cash-flow line includes shares repurchased to settle employee tax withholding on vesting stock awards; the 10-K's repurchase-program table, which excludes those, totals $16,719 million (36 million shares) for fiscal 2026. GEOGRAPHY: 'United States' includes billings to OEMs and certain multinational organizations (10-K footnote a).
